name: Lazarus Pharmaceuticals Compact Bioscan Wand CBW-3
product_name: Lazarus Pharmaceuticals Compact Bioscan Wand CBW-3
description: A handheld scanning device that performs a comprehensive biological assessment when waved over a patient's body — detecting broken bones, internal bleeding, organ damage, foreign objects, toxins in the bloodstream, and neural interface status. The CBW-3 uses a combination of ultrasound, bioimpedance, and chemical sensing to build a holographic body map showing the location and severity of all detected conditions. The scan takes 15 seconds for a full body assessment and requires no physical contact — the wand operates at a distance of up to 30 cm.

specifications.range: Up to 30 cm from body surface
specifications.info: bleeding; organ damage; foreign objects; toxins
specifications.output: Holographic body map on linked display

story_hooks: A CBW-3 scan of a seemingly healthy person revealed a micro-explosive device implanted adjacent to their neural interface — a cortical bomb that the patient did not know they had.
CBW-3 wands have been modified to transmit scan results to unauthorized recipients — every medical scan becomes intelligence about the patient's physical vulnerabilities.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Proprioceptive Lattice Sleeve
Ouroboros Energy ThermalSink UR-3 District Waste Heat Exchange Network

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, wand-shaped medical diagnostic tool with an ergonomic grip. The scanning head tapers to a rounded, slightly translucent tip that houses the sensor array. Resembles a high-tech conductor's baton crossed with a medical thermometer—precision instrument meets clinical utility.
physical_description.dimensions: 28 cm length, 3.5 cm diameter at grip, 2 cm at sensor tip
physical_description.weight_description: 200 grams; lightweight enough for extended single-hand use, pocketable in medical coat or equipment vest
physical_description.primary_material: Matte-finish aerospace-grade composite housing with polycarbonate sensor window
physical_description.finish: Brushed titanium-gray composite body with slightly raised grip texture; translucent sapphire-blue sensor tip for visual distinction
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with sapphire blue accent band at sensor head; subtle teal LED indicators along grip zone
physical_description.interface_elements: Single capacitive power button at grip base; three status indicator LEDs (green/amber/red) along the side; wireless data port (recessed) at grip end; small holographic projection node on underside of wand tip
distinctive_features: Translucent sensor tip with faint internal geometric patterning indicating multi-spectrum array
Soft teal pulse-glow when active, intensifies during scan phase
Minimalist design—no visible screws or seams on body
Grip features subtle grip channels and micro-venting for thermal management
Wand narrows toward tip like a medical implement from early 20th century, modernized
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Lazarus Pharmaceuticals logo (stylized rod of Asclepius) etched beneath power button; regulatory stamps and serial number on grip base; 'CBW-3' model designation on lower barrel
physical_description.condition_typical: Clean, clinical appearance with minor scuff marks on grip from frequent handling; faint fingerprint oils on sensor tip from proximity use; occasionally shows battery indicator glow during active scanning
